display.description: Seed Stockpile quest offer, reminder, and turn-in scene.
display.title: Seed Stockpile

lines: Good. The seed bin remembers patient hands.
Put Seed Stockpile aside for now?

abandoned: I will loosen the seed tally. Come back if the reserve still looks thin.
abandoned_cooldown: I will pause the seed count for now. Let the storehouse settle before asking again.
abandoned_forever: Then the seed reserve request is closed for good.
unavailable: There is no seed tally here to put away.

lines: Then keep the seeds dry until you are ready.
Seed Stockpile is still open. I can repeat the details, or close my notes if you are done.

completed: Seed Stockpile is complete. The village can use this, and you have earned the reward.
inactive: The seed reserve is not taking stock right now.
missing_objectives: Seed Stockpile is still short. The tracker has the exact count.
missing_proof: Seed Stockpile still needs the wheat seeds in your pack before I can close it.
missing_target: Seed Stockpile is not at the right count yet; bring the rest before turning it in.
unavailable: This seed stockpile is not ready to close yet.

lines: Then I will keep pretending the bottom of the bin is farther down.
The seed bin is lower than I like.
If we borrow from the eating grain, spring will arrive with an argument already waiting.

inactive: The seed reserve is not being counted at the moment.
reminder: Seed Stockpile: I still need the wheat seeds. Bring the full count back to me.
unavailable: That seed request is not in your hands right now.

already_completed: The seed reserve is already settled.
locate_failed: Seed Stockpile cannot be posted from here right now.
started: Seed Stockpile is yours now. Bring the wheat seeds back when the count is ready.
unavailable: The seed bin has no work for you right now.

lines: If you have the wheat seeds, we can settle Seed Stockpile.
Keep the wheat seeds dry until the reserve count is ready.
